name: openwork-server
description: Filesystem-backed API for Get3W remote clients

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openwork/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @openwork/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/opencode-v2-context-bridge.ts --outfile dist/opencode-v2-context-bridge.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/opencode-plugins/task-log-evidence-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-chrome-devtools.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-computer-use.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-extensions-preview.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-capabilities-knowledge.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-office-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-spreadsheets.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-pdf-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-anthropic-adaptive-thinking.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-anthropic-tool-schema.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-title-recovery.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-gateway-quota.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-gateway-quota-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-provider-filters-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-mcp-results-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-mcp-readiness-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-visible-reasoning-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-auto-route-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-context-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/openwork-agent-permissions-v2.ts --external effect --root src/opencode-plugins --outdir dist/opencode-plugins --target node --format esm && node scripts/copy-pdfium-wasm.mjs dist/opencode-plugins
scripts.build:bin: pnpm --filter @openwork/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @openwork/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile dist/bin/openwork-server
scripts.build:bin:all: pnpm --filter @openwork/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @openwork/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun ./script/build.ts --outdir dist/bin --target bun-darwin-arm64 --target bun-darwin-x64 --target bun-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-arm64 --target bun-windows-x64 --target bun-windows-arm64
scripts.build:npm-bundle: pnpm --filter @openwork/computer-use build && pnpm --filter @openwork/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build src/cli.ts --target node --format esm --external bun:sqlite --external drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite --external jsonc-parser --outfile dist/npm-bundle/openwork-server.mjs
scripts.test:readiness: bun test test/opencode-stop-fence.test.ts test/opencode-v2-mcp-readiness.test.ts test/openwork-mcp-results-v2.test.ts test/openwork-session-groups.test.ts test/openwork-session-questions.test.ts test/openwork-affordance-args.test.ts test/personal-extension-discovery.test.ts test/personal-cloud-credentials.test.ts test/opencode-v2-instructions.test.ts test/opencode-v2-tool-schemas.test.ts test/openwork-context-computer-gate-v2.test.ts test/engine-v2-mcp-mapping.test.ts test/engine-v2-mcp-reconciliation.test.ts
